name: NullObject
summary: A special case whose behaviour is to do nothing, so that the absence of a collaborator needs no null check.

roles.name: NullObject
roles.summary: The do-nothing member of a protocol. It is a special case narrowed to one behaviour — neutral: its queries answer the identity of whatever the caller does with them, and its commands are accepted and ignored. A special case that answers something meaningful, such as an unknown customer with a default rate, is not one of these.
